text:
elaine_finance: FYI Mediflow disputed invoice MF-2025-11. They were charged $2,750 in burst/overage for Oct 21 and say the traffic spike coincided with our region failover.

michael_sales: quick context - Mediflow has a Dedicated commit (4xA10G equiv) $18,000/mo. On Oct 21 they had a spike and used burst for ~4.2 hours.

dena_csm: support case CASE-12560 attached: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-12560. Customer reports increased 500s and retries from 02:10-06:40 UTC, major impact to ingest pipeline.

ops_kate: infra telemetry shows a control-plane incident at 02:12 that triggered a rolling reschedule; partial degradation window measured: 3.0h. Root cause: control-plane leader election bug; PR to fix merged: https://github.com/redwood/control/pull/6102.

billing-bot: Invoice MF-2025-11: Reserved commit = $18,000; Burst/overage = $2,750; SLA credit applied = $0; Total = $20,750.

elaine_finance: SLA tier: "Partial degradation >=3h and <6h -> 20% credit of monthly Dedicated fee." 20% of $18k = $3,600. Options: (1) Apply SLA credit $3,600 only -> invoice = $17,150 (keep overage), (2) Waive burst $2,750 + apply SLA credit $3,600 = total concession $6,350 -> invoice = $14,400. Waiver is a write-off; need RevOps approval for option 2.

sam_revops: what approvals do you need? I can OK up to $7k concessions if Ops provides RCA note.

michael_sales: customer explicitly asked for the burst fees to be removed and the SLA credit. They're in a tight compliance window, this is high priority.

dena_csm: customer-facing priority is high; they asked for a single-line summary we can send them once resolved.

ops_kate: will add RCA summary to CASE-12560 (one-liner + link to PR). We own the failure. Ops recommends waiving the overage.

elaine_finance: request: sam_revops approve Option 2 and confirm GL handling (waived_overage -> one_time_writeoff; SLA credit -> contractual credit).

sam_revops: Approved. Record: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$2,750; sla_credit=$3,600; total_concession=$6,350. I will note in RevOps ledger and tag for month-end reconciliation.

elaine_finance: thanks. Creating credit memo CM-2025-220 and corrected invoice MF-2025-11-C. Draft reply to customer: "Thanks for flagging this. We've applied a $6,350 concession (includes SLA credit) and issued a corrected invoice MF-2025-11-C. We're sorry for the disruption; ops has rolled a fix and will share the RCA." Posting after docs are generated.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-220 created. Corrected invoice MF-2025-11-C issued.

dena_csm: Sent to customer: "Appreciate the patience — we've issued the credit and updated your invoice. CASE-12560 has the RCA and mitigation timeline." Customer replied: "Thanks, that works for us. Please keep us posted on the fix." :white_check_mark:

elaine_finance: AR updated and dispute closed. Leaving thread for record.

ops_kate: follow-up: will push a post-mortem to the infra channel later today with details and rollout timeline.

michael_sales: nice work team.
